title: 第25章 寻找门派第26章 再遇偷饼之人
content_zh:
欢乐的烟火气息不断袭来，街道上人来人往，他们逛着密集的店铺，地摊上都是各式各样的商品，还有各种新奇的小玩意，灵草灵药也有，一些可以驯服的异能兽也很引人注目，还有一些地方，甚至有卖坐骑，它可以日行百里甚至千里，一般售价极贵，这就是人界麦香国的重大节日——庆生节。
应不会闻到这些飘香的气息，不由得想起在地球逛街时候的场景，是那么的热闹，可惜现在已经回不去了，现在自己每天浑浑噩噩的，既没有钱，也没有吃的，靠着山林里猎杀的野兽，勉强糊口。
闻到这样的香气，不禁让人嘴角流出唾沫，应无悔都感觉有点嘴馋，可是，没办法，一块异能币都没有，能干些什么呢？只能眼睁睁的看着，这里还有许多管理秩序的异能护卫，他们都是一级或者二级的异能师，领头的可能高达三级。
“平时可见不到这样的盛况，老弟，只有一年一度的庆生节，才会这样”
“哇，那是什么？浑身散发着光的草，还有那个长得像猿猴一样的，那么一个庞然大物”
“老弟呀，这你就不懂了，我以前当异能师的时候，对这些东西早就见怪不怪，这些是灵药，形态各异，发着灵光，还有这个庞然大物名叫山猿，一级中阶异能兽，可以被人类驯化，成为不可多得的帮手”
这位中年人说道，“还是大人见多识广，小的还要多多向您学习”
那位小伙子说道。
“唉，不敢当，不敢当，老夫还得仰仗你们家族呢”
两个人有说有笑的，他们其中一些内容被应无悔听到。
一个是普通的凡人，但是家里很有钱，另一个应该是一个一级初阶或者中阶的异能师，勉勉强强挤进异能师的行列。
其实应无悔本来不会分析异能师的等级强弱，这都是狱火行者教的好，他讲的清晰明白，让人一下子就懂。
人类的异能能量一般以蓝色为主，极少数是其他颜色，一级淡蓝色，二级深蓝色，三级发着亮光的深蓝色，四级灰蓝色，五级薄蓝色。
由浅到深，再由深到浅，这是力量的一种提升而后不断升华凝练，其异能的容量，比一般的异能能量，高出几倍到几十倍不等。
天赋早已经定好了框架，提升带来的不过是异能的质量越大，就如不断压缩的异能，虽然如一个小球一般，但其释放的威能，足以和低等级的异能师所有的异能容量一样。
这东西类似于地球上的密度，应无悔想着。
“新鲜的冰糖葫芦哦，冰糖葫芦！”
“现做羊奶，现磨茶粉！”
“各国的新奇玩具，这里都有！”
“香香的肉麦饼！”

“猪肉店铺打折啦！”
“孜然烤肉串，走过路过，不要错过”
“海鲜，海鲜，海中鲜味之王，大海里的这里都有，爱吃的朋友赶紧来！”
凡人的吆喝着。
另一边，是异能师的摊子，他们通常有异能道具，帮他们吆喝叫卖，也有直接像投屏一样投在前面，跟电视机差不多，那里显示着他那里有什么东西卖，自己则静静的坐在摊子上，等着人过来。
异能师卖的东西，肯定是比凡人贵很多的，当然也有便宜的，大多数过来选购的也是异能师，对于凡人来说，买了这些东西，对于他们来说基本没用，然而，有一些灵草灵药可以治病救人，有一些凡人倾家荡产，也会过来买，前提是他真的想救那个人的命，不然也不至于冲动到会购买这昂贵的灵药。
有些异能师，就靠卖灵药赚钱，还卖一些草药，来往的人总是络绎不绝，可是他们根本不知道，来售卖的这些人只是门中后勤资源部中的普通治疗师而已。
只有极少数，是其他国家来的，他们卖的东西和这里的大不相同，当然药效，也是立马见得着的。
卖灵草灵药是最赚钱的，因为争斗而受伤的异能师，护送保卫的异能师，猎杀异能兽的异能师，还有凡人的疾病，这些要是个人都逃不过，所以这个行业非常赚钱，许多人不奔着修为去，而是奔着钱去，只要有足够多的钱，虽然不能在这个大陆纵横，但富甲一方结交更多道行高的朋友是完全有可能的。
不过终究是力量说了算的世界，他们赚这些钱，如果没有强大的人保护，被拖走也是常有的事。
应无悔很想吃东西，这么一两个月，吃的都是放在火堆上烤的兽肉，他早就吃腻了，可兜里又没钱，总不能直接抢吧。
“快抓小偷！
有人偷拿我家的肉饼！
乡亲邻里，赶紧过来帮忙！”
店铺老板大声道，那个小偷浑身破破烂烂的，跑得却十分迅速，披头散发的跟炸毛的鸟窝一样，应无悔一眼便看到他，那个乞丐男孩，疯狂的将大饼往自己嘴里面塞，对后面最值的人，完全不管不顾。
“小崽子，站住！
我定要打断你的狗腿！”
店铺老板家的伙计大声呵斥道，还有两个人也是店铺的伙计，三个小伙子在追一个小男孩，这男孩看样子有十三四岁，也算一个少年郎，可他为什么要偷别人的东西呢？
应无悔，虽然穿得还行，但衣服也已经有点脏旧了，他很想换掉，但是没办法，身无分文呐！
应无悔没有理会这些事情，转而继续向前走去，很多地方都贴着告示牌，有招募各种工作的，这种工作招募是分开的，凡人的招聘工作为一个牌子，而异能师的招聘工作的牌子则更加的大，是普通凡人招募栏的至少两倍，这个世界对异能师的需求太大了，凡人必须受到他们的保护，不然以他们区区弱小的身体，怎么能够生活在这个危险的世界上呢。

一个招聘异能师的公告栏前，围满了人，应无悔挤在后面，前面有太多人挡住了他，他不断跳起来才勉强能看清楚几个字。
“瀚海门，招募围猎异能兽的异能师一名……还有许多其他工作，人数不多，只招十个”
看来这是瀚海门的境地，呼，走出炎门，这个鬼地方就好。

content_en:
The smell of joyful fireworks keeps coming, and people come and go on the streets. They browse the densely packed shops. The stalls are full of all kinds of goods, as well as all kinds of novel gadgets. There are also spiritual herbs and elixirs. Some tamable supernatural beasts are also very eye-catching. In some places, there are even mounts for sale. They can travel hundreds or even thousands of miles a day. Generally, the price is extremely expensive. This is the major festival of Maixiang Kingdom in the human world - the Birthday Festival.
I shouldn't be able to smell these fragrant smells, and I can't help but think of the scene when I was shopping on Earth. It was so lively. Unfortunately, I can't go back now. Now I am in a muddle every day, with neither money nor food, and I can barely survive by hunting wild beasts in the mountains and forests.
Smelling such a fragrance, one can't help but salivate from the corner of one's mouth. Ying Wuhui even feels a little greedy, but there is no way, what can you do if you don't even have a single power coin? I can only watch helplessly. There are many supernatural guards here who manage order. They are all first- or second-level psychics, and the leader may be as high as third-level.
"We don't usually see such grand events, brother, it's only the annual birthday celebration that happens like this."
"Wow, what is that? The grass that is full of light, and the one that looks like an ape, such a huge thing."
"Brother, you don't understand this. When I was a superpower master, I was not surprised by these things. These are elixirs with different shapes and emitting spiritual light. There is also this behemoth called Mountain Ape, a first-level mid-level superpower beast that can be domesticated by humans and become a rare helper."
The middle-aged man said, "Adults are still well-informed, and young people should learn more from you."
said the young man.
"Oh, I don't dare to take it. I don't dare to take it. I still have to rely on your family."
The two were talking and laughing, and some of their content was heard by Ying Wuhui.
One is an ordinary mortal, but his family is very rich, and the other should be a first-level elementary or intermediate psychic, barely squeezing into the ranks of psychics.
In fact, Ying Wuhui didn't know how to analyze the level of power masters. This was all taught well by Hellfire Walker. He explained it clearly and clearly, making people understand it at once.
Humans' supernatural energy is generally mainly blue, with very few other colors, the first level is light blue, the second level is dark blue, the third level is bright dark blue, the fourth level is gray blue, and the fifth level is thin blue.
From shallow to deep, and then from deep to shallow, this is an improvement in power, and then it is continuously sublimated and condensed. The capacity of its superpowers is several to dozens of times higher than ordinary superpower energy.
The talent framework has already been set. What improvement brings is the greater the quality of the superpower, just like the continuously compressed superpower. Although it is like a small ball, the power it releases is enough to be the same as the superpower capacity of a low-level superpower.
This thing is similar to the density on the earth, Ying Wuhui thought.
"Fresh candied haws on a stick, candied haws on a stick!"
"Freshly made goat milk, freshly ground tea powder!"
“Novel toys from all over the world are available here!”
“Fragrant meat and wheat cakes!”
“The pork shop has a discount!”
“Cumin kebab, don’t miss it if you’re passing by”
"Seafood, seafood, the king of delicious food in the sea, is available here in the sea. Friends who love food, come quickly!"
Mortals shouted.
On the other side is the stall of the superpower master. They usually have superpower props that help them shout and sell, or they can be directly projected in front of them like a screen, similar to a TV. It shows what they have for sale, while I sit quietly on the stall, waiting for people to come over.
The things sold by psychic masters are definitely much more expensive than those of mortals. Of course, there are also cheaper ones. Most of the people who come to buy are also psychic masters. For mortals, buying these things is basically useless to them. However, there are some spiritual herbs and elixirs that can cure diseases and save people. Some mortals who have lost all their money will come to buy them. BeforeProvided that he really wanted to save that person's life, otherwise he wouldn't have been so impulsive as to buy this expensive elixir.
Some psychics make money by selling elixirs and some herbal medicines. There is always an endless stream of people coming and going, but they have no idea that these people who come to sell are just ordinary therapists in the sect's logistics resources department.
There are only a handful of them from other countries, and the things they sell are very different from those here. Of course, the effects of the medicine are immediately visible.
Selling spiritual herbs and elixirs is the most profitable. The psychics who are injured in battles, the psychics who escort and defend, the psychics who hunt supernatural beasts, and the diseases of mortals are all things that no individual can escape. Therefore, this industry is very profitable. Many people do not go for cultivation, but for money. As long as they have enough money, it is entirely possible for the rich to make more friends with high moral standards, although they cannot travel around this continent.
But after all, it is a world where power has the final say. If they earn this money, if they are not protected by powerful people, it is common for them to be dragged away.
Ying Wuhui really wanted to eat. For a month or two, all he ate was animal meat roasted on the fire. He had long been tired of it, but he had no money in his pocket, so he couldn't just grab it.
“Catch the thief quickly!
Someone stole my meatloaf!
Folks and neighbors, come and help! "
The shop owner said loudly, the thief was in tatters, but he ran very fast, and his hair was as disheveled as a bird's nest with fried feathers. Ying Wuhui saw him at a glance. The beggar boy crazily stuffed the pie into his mouth, completely ignoring the most valuable person behind him.
"Baby, stop!
I will definitely break your dog legs! "
The store owner's clerk yelled loudly, and there were two other people who were also store clerks. Three young men were chasing a little boy. The boy looked to be thirteen or fourteen years old, and he could be considered a young man. But why would he steal other people's things?
Ying Wuhui, although he was well dressed, his clothes were a little dirty and old. He wanted to change them, but he had no choice, he was penniless!
Ying Wuhui ignored these things and continued to walk forward. There were notice boards posted in many places, recruiting for various jobs. The recruitment for these jobs was separate. The recruitment for mortals was on the same sign, while the sign for recruitment of psychics was even larger, at least twice that of ordinary mortals. The demand for psychics in this world was too great, and mortals must be protected by them. Otherwise, how could they live in this dangerous world with their weak bodies.
A bulletin board recruiting superpowers was crowded with people. Ying Wuhui was squeezing in the back. There were too many people in front of him, blocking him. He kept jumping up and could barely read a few words clearly.
"Hanhaimen, recruit a psychic to hunt supernatural beasts... there are many other jobs, the number of people is not large, only ten are recruited."
It seems that this is the situation of Hanhaimen. Huh, just get out of Yanmen and this ghost place will be fine.
